sections.title: The victory of Canaan.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ ከሞተ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የሙሴን አገልጋይ የነዌን ልጅ ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“አገልጋዬ ሙሴ ሞቶአል፤ አሁንም አንተና ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተነሥታችሁ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደምሰጣቸው ምድር ይህን ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገሩ።
ለሙሴ እንደ ነገርሁት የእግራችሁ ጫማ የሚረግጠውን ቦታ ሁሉ ለእናንተ ሰጥቼአለሁ።
ከሊባኖስ ፊት ለፊት ምድረ በዳ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ወንዝ እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ድረስ የኬጤዎናውያን ምድር ሁሉ እስከ ፀሐይ መግቢያ እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ወሰናችሁ ይሆናል።
በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ የሚቋቋምህ የለም፤ ከሙሴ ጋር እንደ ነበርሁ እንዲሁ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፤ አልጥልህም፥ ቸልም አልልህም።
ለአባቶቻቸው እሰጣቸው ዘንድ የማልሁላቸውን ምድር ለዚህ ሕዝብ ታወርሳለህና ጽና፥ በርታ።
አገልጋዬ ሙሴ እንደ አዘዘህ ሕግን ሁሉ ትጠብቅና ታደርግ ዘንድ ጽና፤ እጅግም በርታ፤ ሁሉን እንዴት እንደምትሠራ ታውቅ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ወደ ቀኝ ወደ ግራም አትበል።
የዚህ ሕግ መጽሐፍ ከአፍህ አይለይ፤ ነገር ግን የተጻፈበትን ሁሉ ትጠብቅና ታደርግ ዘንድ በቀንም በሌሊትም አንብበው፤ የዚያን ጊዜም መንገድህ ይቀናልሃል፤ አስተዋይም ትሆናለህ።
እነሆ አዝዝሃለሁ፤ በምትሄድበት ሁሉ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና ጽና፥ በርታ፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥም።”
ኢያሱም የሕዝቡን ጻፎች እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው፦

"In the midst of the camp, on the third day, you shall prepare yourselves, for the Lord your God, the God of your fathers, will give you a heritage, and you shall cross this Jordan to inherit the land that He gives you."
And he spoke unto them, saying, "I have commanded you, O Reuben and Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, in this manner."
"The servant of the Lord, Moses, commanded you, saying, 'The Lord your God will give you rest; and He will give you this land.'"

"Your wives and your children and your livestock shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan; but you, all you men of valor, shall pass over armed before your brethren, and help them."

"The Lord our God will not cease to give you rest until your brethren also inherit the land which the Lord our God gives them; and afterward, each of you shall return to your possession, which Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave you, on the east side of the Jordan."
And they answered Joshua, saying, "All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us, we will go."
"Just as we heeded Moses in all things, so we will heed you; only may the Lord your God be with you, as He was with Moses."
"Whoever rebels against your command and does not heed your words in all that you command him, he shall be put to death; only be strong and of good courage."

sections.title: And Jesus sent forth the messengers unto Jericho.

verses.text: የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ “ውጡና ምድሪቱን ኢያሪኮን እዩ” ብሎ ከሰጢም ሁለት ጐልማሶች ሰላዮችን በስውር ላከ። እነዚያም ሁለት ጐልማሶች ሄዱ፤ ወደ ኢያሪኮም ደረሱ፤ ረዓብ ወደሚሉአትም ዘማ ቤት ገቡ፤ በዚያም ዐደሩ።
ለኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ፥ “እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ሰላዮች ሀገራችንን ሊሰልሉ ወደዚህ በሌሊት ገቡ” ብለው ነገሩት።
የኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ፥ “ሀገራችንን ሁሉ ሊሰልሉ መጥተዋልና ወደ አንቺ የመጡትን በዚችም ሌሊት ወደ ቤትሽ የገቡትን ሰዎች አውጪ በሉአት” ብሎ ወደ ረዓብ ላከ።
ሴቲቱም ሁለቱን ሰዎች ወስዳ ሸሸገቻቸው፤ እርስዋም፥ “አዎን፥ ሰዎቹ ወደ እኔ መጡ፤ ከወዴት እንደ ሆኑ ግን አላወቅሁም፤
በሩም ሲዘጋ፥ ሲጨልምም ሰዎቹ ወጡ፤ ወዴት እንደ ሄዱ አላውቅም፤ ፈጥናችሁ ተከተሉአቸው፤ ምንአልባት ታገኙአቸው ይሆናል” አለቻቸው።
እርስዋ ግን ወደ ሰገነቱ አውጥታ በተከመረ እንጨት መካከል በቀርከሃ ጠቅልላ ደብቃቸው ነበር።
ሰዎቹም ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መሻገሪያ በሚወስደው መንገድ ተከተሉአቸው፤ በሩም ተቈለፈ።
እነዚህም ሳይተኙ ሴቲቱ ወደ እነርሱ ወደ ሰገነቱ ወጣች።
ሰዎቹንም እንዲህ አለቻቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር ምድሪቱን አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጣችሁ ዐወቅሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር እናንተን መፍራትን በላያችን አምጥትዋልና፥ በምድሪቱም የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ የተነሣ ቀልጠዋልና።
ከግብፅ ምድር በወጣችሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር የኤርትራን ባሕር በፊታችሁ እንዳደረቀ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በነበሩት፥ እናንተም ፈጽማችሁ ባጠፋችኋቸው በሁለቱ በአሞራውያን ነገሥታት፥ በሴዎንና በዐግ ያደረጋችሁትን ሰምተናል።
And we have heard this matter, and our hearts rejoiced; for your God, the Lord, is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other. Therefore, from you, not one soul shall be lost.
Now, I beseech you by the Lord, as I have shown you kindness, so you also show kindness to the house of my father; and give me a true sign.
The house of my father, and my mother, and my brothers, and all my household, save them; and deliver our lives from death.

And the men said, "For your sake we will be ready to give our lives to death." And she said, "The Lord will show you kindness and truth when He gives you the land." And the men said, "If you do not declare this matter, we will show you kindness and truth when the Lord gives us the land."
And her house was built into the city wall, and she dwelt upon the wall; and she let down a cord through the window.
And she said to them, "Go to the mountain, lest your pursuers find you; hide yourselves there three days until the pursuers return; and afterward you may go your way."
And the men answered her, "We will be blameless of this oath which you have made us swear."

Behold, when we come into the land, you shall bind this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down; and you shall gather your father and your mother, your brothers, and all your father's household to your home.

And whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be upon his own head, and we will be guiltless; but whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head if a hand is laid on him.
But if you tell this business of ours, then we will be free from your oath which you made us swear.
And she said, "Let it be as your word"; and they were comforted; and they went away; and she looked towards the door, and it was as if she had turned her face.
And they departed and went to the mountain; and they remained there for three days until they returned, and they found them not on their way.
And the two messengers returned; and they descended from the mountain and went forth; and they came to Jonah the son of Amittai; and they told him all that had befallen them.
And they said to Jonah, "Truly the Lord has delivered all the land into our hands; and all the peoples that dwell in that land have melted away before us."

sections.title: Israel crossed over the Jordan River as they had been commanded.

verses.text: ኢያሱም ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ እርሱና እስራኤልም ሁሉ ከሰጢም ተጕዘው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጡ፤ ሳይሻገሩም በዚያ አደሩ።
ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ጸሓፊዎች በሰፈሩ መካከል ገቡ።
ለሕዝቡም እንዲህ ብለው ዐወጁ፥ “የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ሌዋውያንና ካህናት ተሸክመውት ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ከሰፈራችሁ ተነሥታችሁ ተከተሉት።
በእናንተና በታቦቱ መካከል ያለው ርቀት በስፍር ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ ያህል ይሁን፤ በዚህ መንገድ በፊት አልሄዳችሁበትምና የምትሄዱበትን መንገድ እንድታውቁ ወደ ታቦቱ አትቅረቡ።”
ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን፥ “ነገ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ ድንቅ ነገር ያደርጋልና ራሳችሁን አንጹ” አለ።
ኢያሱም ካህናቱን፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ተሸክማችሁ በሕዝቡ ፊት ሂዱ” ብሎ ተናገራቸው፤ ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ተሸክመው በሕዝቡ ፊት ሄዱ።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “ከሙሴ ጋር እንደ ሆንሁ እንዲሁ ከአንተ ጋር መሆኔን ያውቁ ዘንድ በዚህ ቀን በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ፊት ከፍ ከፍ አደርግህ ዘንድ እጀምራለሁ።
አሁንም አንተ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የሚሸከሙትን ካህናት በዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ዳር ስትደርሱ በዮርዳኖስ ውስጥ ቁሙ ብለህ እዘዝ” አለው።
ኢያሱም ለእስራኤል ልጆች፥ “ወደዚህ ቀርባችሁ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ” አለ።
ኢያሱም አለ፥ “ሕያው አምላክ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እርሱም ከፊታችሁ ከነዓናዊውን፥ ኬጤዎናዊውንም፥ ኤዌዎናዊውንም፥ ፌርዜዎናዊውንም፥ ጌርጌሴዎናዊውንም፥ አሞሬዎናዊውንም፥ ኢያቡሴዎናዊውንም ፈጽሞ እንዲያጠፋቸው በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ።
እነሆ፥ የምድር ሁሉ ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት በፊታችሁ ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገራለች።
አሁንም ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ዐሥራ ሁለት ሰዎችን ምረጡ፤ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሰው ይሁን።
እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የምድርን ሁሉ ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት እግር ጫማ በዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ውስጥ ሲቆም፥ የዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ይደርቃል፤ ከላይ የሚወርደውም ውኃ ይቆማል።”
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሕዝቡ ዮርዳኖስን ሊሻገሩ ከየድንኳናቸው በወጡ ጊዜ፥ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት በሕዝቡ ፊት ይሄዱ ነበር።
እንደ ክረምትና እንደ መከር ወራት ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስ እስከ ወሰኑ ሞልቶ ነበርና የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ተሸካሚዎቹ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ በገቡ ጊዜ፥ ታቦቱን የተሸከሙት የካህናቱ እግሮች በውኃዉ ዳር ሲጠልቁ፥
ከላይ የሚወርደው ውኃ ቆመ፤ እስከ ቀርያትያርም አውራጃ እጅግ ርቆ እንደ ግድግዳ ቆመ፤ ወደ ዓረባ ባሕር ወደ ጨው ባሕር የሚወርደው ውኃም ፈጽሞ ደረቀ፤ ሕዝቡም በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት ቆሙ።
የእግዚአብሔርንም የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት በዮርዳኖስ መካከል በደረቅ መሬት ጸንተው ቆመው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን ፈጽመው እስኪሻገሩ ድረስ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በደረቅ መሬት ተሻገሩ።

sections.title: Israel, do not let the stones of remembrance be forgotten.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን ፈጽመው በተሻገሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ከሕዝቡ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሰው፥ ዐሥራ ሁለት ሰዎችን ውሰድ፦
በዮርዳኖስ መካከል የካህናት እግር ከቆመበት ስፍራ ዐሥራ ሁለት ቀላል ድንጋዮችን እንዲያነሡ እዘዛቸው፤ ከእናንተም ጋር ውሰዱአቸው፤ ከዚያም ሌሊት በምታድሩበት ቦታ በየነገዳችሁ ጠብቋቸው።”
ኢያሱም ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሰው፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች የታወቁትን ዐሥራ ሁለት ሰዎች ጠራ።
ኢያሱም አላቸው፥ “በእኔና በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መካከል ዕለፉ፤ እያንዳንዱ ሰው በዐሥራ ሁለቱ ነገደ እስራኤል ቍጥር በትከሻው ላይ አንድ አንድ ድንጋይ ከዚያ ይሸከም።
እነዚህም ምልክት ይሆኑላችኋል፤ ልጅህ ነገ፦ ‘እነዚህ ድንጋዮች ምንድን ናቸው?’ ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ፥ ልጅህን እንዲህ ትለዋለህ፦
አንተ በምድር ሁሉ ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ስንሻገር የዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ስለ ደረቀ ነው፤ እነዚህ ድንጋዮችም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ለዘለዓለም መታሰቢያ ይሆናሉ።”
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢያሱ እንዳዘዛቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ዮርዳኖስን አካትተው በተሻገሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን እንደ አዘዘው በእስራኤል ነገድ ቍጥር ከዮርዳኖስ መካከል ዐሥራ ሁለት ድንጋዮች አንሥተው ወደ ሰፈራቸው ወሰዱ፤ በዚያም አኖሩአቸው።
ኢያሱም የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት እግሮች በቆሙበት ስፍራ በዮርዳኖስ መካከል ሌሎች ዐሥራ ሁለት ድንጋዮችን አቆመ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በዚያ አሉ።
ኢያሱም ለሕዝቡ እንዲነግር፥ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ሁሉ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የተሸከሙ ካህናት በዮርዳኖስ መካከል ቆመው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ፈጥነው ተሻገሩ።
ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አካትተው በተሻገሩ ጊዜ ታቦተ ሕጉ ተሻገረች፤ እነዚያም ድንጋዮች በፊታቸው ተሻገሩ።
ሙሴም እንዳዘዛቸው የሮቤል ልጆች፥ የጋድም ልጆች፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ታጥቀው በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ተሻገሩ።
አርባ ሺህ ያህል ለጦርነት የታጠቁ ሰዎች የኢያሪኮን ሀገር ይወጉ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ተሻገሩ።
በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ፊት ከፍ አደረገው፤ ሙሴንም እንደ ፈሩ በዕድሜው ሁሉ ፈሩት።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት የሚሸከሙትን ካህናት ከዮርዳኖስ እንዲወጡ እዘዛቸው።”
ኢያሱም ካህናቱን፥ “ከዮርዳኖስ ውጡ” ብሎ አዘዛቸው።
የእግዚአብሔርንም የቃል ኪዳን ታቦተ ሕግ የተሸከሙ ካህናት ከዮርዳኖስ መካከል በወጡ ጊዜ፥ በእግራቸውም የብስ በረገጡ ጊዜ፥ የዮርዳኖስ ውኃ ተወርውሮ ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ፤ ቀድሞም እንደ ነበረ ሂዶ ዳር እስከ ዳር ሞላ።
ሕዝቡም በመጀመሪያው ወር በዐሥረኛው ቀን ከዮርዳኖስ ወጡ፤ በኢያሪኮም በምሥራቅ በኩል በጌልገላ ሰፈሩ።
ኢያሱም ከዮርዳኖስ ውስጥ የወሰዱአቸውን እነዚያን ዐሥራ ሁለቱን ድንጋዮች በጌልገላ አቆማቸው።
And Jesus spoke unto the children of Israel, saying, “When your children shall ask you, ‘What mean these stones?’ in that day,
ye shall answer them, saying, ‘Israel passed over this Jordan on dry ground;’
For the Lord our God dried up the waters of the Red Sea from before us, until we were gone over; and He did likewise to the waters of the Jordan, which were dried up from before us.
That all the people of the earth might know the mighty hand of the Lord, that ye might fear the Lord your God forever.”

And it came to pass; that all the kings of the Amorites who were on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we had crossed over; and their hearts melted, and there was no spirit in them any longer because of the children of Israel.

sections.title: And the children of Israel were gathered together in Gilgal.

verses.text: በዚያን ጊዜም እግዚአብሔር ኢያሱን፥ “ከሻፎ ድንጋይ የባልጩት መቍረጫ ሠርተህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ዳግመኛ ግረዛቸው” አለው።
ኢያሱም የባልጩት መቍረጫ ሠርቶ የግርዛት ኮረብታ በተባለ ስፍራ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ገረዘ።
ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ የገረዘበት ምክንያት ይህ ነው፤ ከግብፅ የወጡ ወንዶች ተዋጊዎች ሁሉ ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ በመንገድ ላይ በምድረ በዳ ሞቱ፤ የወጡትም ወንዶች ሁሉ ተገርዘው ነበር።
ነገር ግን ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ በመንገድ፥ በምድረ በዳ የተወለዱ ሕዝብ ሁሉ አልተገረዙም ነበርና፥ ኢያሱ እነዚህን ሁሉ ገረዛቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድር ለእኛ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን የማለላቸውን ምድር እንደማያሳያቸው የማለባቸውን፥ ከግብፅ የወጡ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ያልሰሙ፥ እነዚያ ተዋጊዎች ሁሉ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ የእስራኤል ልጆች አርባ ዓመት በመድበራ ምድረ በዳ ይዞሩ ነበር።
ልጆቻቸውን በእነርሱ ፋንታ አስነሣ፤ እነዚህንም ኢያሱ ገረዛቸው፤ በመንገድ ስለተወለዱ አልተገረዙም ነበርና።
በተገረዙም ጊዜ እስኪድኑ ድረስ በሰፈር ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “ዛሬ የግብፅን ተግዳሮት ከእናንተ ላይ አስወግጃለሁ” አለው፤ ስለዚህ የዚያ ስፍራ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ጌልገላ ተብሎ ተጠራ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች በጌልገላ ሰፈሩ፤ ከወሩም በዐሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በኢያሪኮ ምዕራብ ፋሲካን አደረጉ።
ከምድሪቱም ፍሬ ቂጣና አዲስ እህል በዚያው ቀን በሉ።

And in the evening, after the children of Israel had eaten the fruit of the land, the manna ceased; and thereafter the children of Israel did not have manna any more; but in that year they gathered the fruits of the land of Canaan.

sections.title: And Jesus, having the sword of the Spirit, was a man.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua was near Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked; and behold, there stood a man over against him with a drawn sword in his hand. And Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, “Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?”
And he said, “Nay; but as the captain of the host of the Lord am I now come.” And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, “What saith my lord unto his servant?”
And the captain of the Lord's host said unto Joshua, “Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy.” And Joshua did so.

sections.title: The Fall of the Walls of Jericho

verses.text: And Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel; none went out, and none came in.
And the Lord said unto Joshua, “Behold, I have given into thy hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valor.”
Thou shalt also compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns; and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

And it shall come to pass, when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
And Joshua called the priests, and said unto them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the Lord.”
And he said unto the people, “Pass on, and compass the city, and let the armed men pass on before the ark of the Lord.”

And the Lord commanded Joshua, saying, “Thus shall ye do with the seven priests who bear the seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the Lord; and they shall go on, and blow the trumpets, and ye shall follow them.”
And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on and blowing with the trumpets.
And Joshua charged the people, saying, “Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.”
የእግዚአብሔርም የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ሄደች፤ ከተማዪቱንም ዞረች፤ ወደ ሰፈርም ተመልሳ በዚያ አደረች።
ኢያሱም በማግሥቱ ማለዳ ተነሣ፤ ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን የሕጉን ታቦት ተሸከሙ።
ሰባቱም ካህናት ሰባቱን ቀንደ መለከት ይዘው በእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ፊት ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ቀንደ መለከቱንም ይነፉ ነበር፤ ተዋጊዎችም በፊታቸው ይሄዱ ነበር፤ የቀሩትም ሕዝብ ከእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በኋላ ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ካህናቱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ይነፉ ነበር።
በሁለተኛውም ቀን የቀረው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከተማዪቱን አንድ ጊዜ ዞረው ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሱ፤ ስድስት ቀንም እንዲህ አደረጉ።
በሰባተኛውም ቀን በነጋ ጊዜ ማልደው ተነሡ፤ እንደዚህም ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ ዞሩ፤ በዚያም ቀን ብቻ ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ ዞሩ።
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከተማዪቱን ሰባት ጊዜ በዞሩና ካህናቱ ቀንደ መለከቱን በነፉ ጊዜ፤ ኢያሱ ለእስራኤል ልጆች አለ፥ “እግዚአብሔር ከተማዪቱን ሰጥቶአችኋልና ጩኹ።
ከተማዪቱም በእርስዋም ያለው ሁሉ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር እርም ይሆናሉ፤ የላክናቸውን መልእክተኞች ስለ ሸሸገች ዘማዊቱ ረዓብ፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር በቤቷ ውስጥ ያሉ ሁሉ ብቻ በሕይወት ይኖራሉ።
እናንተ ግን እርም ብለን ከተውነው እንዳትወስዱ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ከእርሱም ተመኝታችሁ አትውሰዱ፤ ብትወስዱ ግን የእስራኤልን ሰፈር የተረገመች ታደርጓታላችሁ፤ እኛንም ታጠፉናላችሁ።
ነገር ግን ብርና ወርቅ ሁሉ፥ የናስና የብረትም ዕቃ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሁን፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ግምጃ ቤት ይግባ።”
ሕዝቡም ጮኹ፥ ካህናቱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ነፉ፤ ሕዝቡም የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ በሰሙ ጊዜ ታላቅ ጩኸት ጮኹ፤ ቅጥሩም ወደቀ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ከተማዪቱ ገቡ፤ ሁሉም ወደ ፊታቸው ወደ ከተማዪቱ ሮጡ፤ ከተማዪቱንም እጅ አደረጉ።
And Jesus destroyed all that were in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, both cattle and sheep, and horses, with the edge of the sword; He utterly destroyed them.
And Jesus commanded the two men who had been sent, saying, “Go into the house of the harlot; and bring out from there the woman and all that she has, as you have sworn to her.”

And those two men who had been sent entered the house of the harlot and brought out Rahab, her father and her mother, and her brothers, and all that she had, and they brought out all her relatives; and they set them outside the camp of Israel.
And they burned the city with fire, and all that was therein; only the silver and the gold, and the vessels of brass and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.
And Jesus sent messengers to Jericho, and because she had hidden the spies, He saved Rahab, her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwells in Israel to this day.
On that day, Jesus said, “Cursed be the man who rises up to build this city, Jericho; he shall lay its foundation with his firstborn, and with his youngest son shall he set up its gates.”
And the Lord was with Jesus; and His fame was spread throughout all the earth.

sections.title: The sin of Achan.

verses.text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord was angry with them because of their deeds. For there was a man of the tribe of Judah, the son of Carmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, who committed this great sin, and the Lord was provoked against the children of Israel.
And Joshua spoke to the people, saying, “Go forth, and let the men of the city of Jericho come out to you,” and they went forth, and the men of Jericho came out to them.
And they returned to Joshua, saying, “If two or three thousand men go up to fight against them, the whole people will not go up; but do not send all the people there, for they are few.”
And about three thousand men went up there; but the men of Jericho chased them, and they fled before them.

And the men of Jericho struck down thirty-six of them; they chased them from before the gate as far as Shebarim, and struck them down on the descent; and the hearts of the people melted, and became like water.
And Joshua tore his clothes, and he and the elders of Israel fell upon their faces before the ark of the Lord until evening, and they put dust upon their heads.

And Joshua said, “Alas, O Lord God! Why have You brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? Would that we had been content to dwell beyond the Jordan!”
O Lord! What shall I say when Israel turns its back before its enemies?
And the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and they will surround us and cut off our name from the earth; and what will You do for Your great name?
And the Lord said to Joshua, “Why do you fall on your face?”
ሕዝቡ በድለዋል፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር የገባሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አፍርሰዋል፤ እርም ከሆነውም ነገር ሰርቀው ወሰዱ፤ በዕቃቸውም ውስጥ ሸሸጉት።
ስለዚህም የእስራኤል ልጆች በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት መቆም አይችሉም፤ የተረገሙ ስለሆኑ በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት ይሸሻሉ፤ እርም የሆነውንም ነገር ከመካከላችሁ ካላጠፋችሁ ከዚህ በኋላ ከእናንተ ጋር አልሆንም።
ተነሣና ሕዝቡን ቀድስ እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ‘እስራኤል ሆይ! እርም የሆነ ነገር በመካከልህ አለ፤ እርምም የሆነውን ነገር ከመካከላችሁ እስክታጠፉ ድረስ በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት መቆም አትችሉም’ ብሎ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና እስከ ነገ ራሳችሁን አንጹ።
ነገም በየነገዳችሁ ትቀርባላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚለየው ነገድ በየወገኖቹ ይቀርባል፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚለየው ወገን በየቤተ ሰቦቹ ይቀርባል፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚለየው ቤተ ሰብ በየሰዉ ይቀርባል።
ምልክት የታየበት ሰው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን አፍርሶአልና፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ በደል አድርጎአልና፥ እርሱና ያለው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ።”
ኢያሱም ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ እስራኤልንም በየነገዶቻቸው ሰበሰባቸው፤ በይሁዳም ነገድ ላይ ምልክት ታየ፤
የይሁዳም ወገኖች ተለዩ፤ በዛራም ወገን ምልክት ታየ፤ የዛራም ወገን በየቤተ ሰቡ ተለየ፤
በዘንበሪም ወገን ምልክት ታየ፤ የዘንበሪም ቤተ ሰብ እያንዳንዱ ተለየ፤ ከይሁዳም ወገን በሆነ በከርሚ ልጅ በዘንበሪ ልጅ በዛራ ልጅ በአካን ላይ ምልክት ታየ።
ኢያሱም አካንን፥ “ልጄ ሆይ! ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ስጥ፤ ለእርሱም ተናዘዝ፤ ያደረግኸውንም ንገረኝ፤ አትሸሽገኝም” አለው።
አካንም መልሶ ኢያሱን፥ “በእውነት በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በድያለሁ፤ እንዲህና እንዲህም አድርጌአለሁ።

"In the midst of the seraphim, there was one that was beautiful, two hundred shekels of silver, and its weight was fifty shekels of gold; I did not desire them, and I was sent away; behold, they have been hidden in the earth within the tomb; it is brighter than all that is beneath."
And He sent messengers; and they ran to the tomb and to the sepulcher; behold, He was enclosed within the sepulcher, and the brightness was above Him.
And they brought forth all the mourners from the sepulcher unto Jesus and unto all the mourners of Israel; and they dwelt before the Lord.

And Jesus took the son of Zarean, and the brightness, and his garment, and the golden belt, and sent them unto the brook of Achor; and the men and women, and his children, and the oxen, and the horses, and the goods, and all the possessions were sent unto the brook of Achor.

Jesus said, "Why have You caused us to perish? Today, as You have caused us to perish, may the Lord cause You to perish," and all Israel were stoned; and they were consumed by fire; and they were stoned.
And until this day, there remains a great heap of stones from the ruins; and the Lord turned from His wrath. Therefore, that place has been called Achor until this day.

sections.title: The city of Gai is to be laid waste.

verses.text: And the Lord said to Joshua, “Fear not; do not be dismayed; take all the people of war with you, arise and go up to Ai; behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, his people, the city, and the land.”
“As you have done to Jericho and its king, so you shall do to Ai and its king; only its spoil and its cattle you shall take as plunder for yourselves; lay an ambush for the city behind it,” he said.
And Joshua and all the people of war arose and went up to Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand mighty men of valor and sent them out by night.
Thus he commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind it; do not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.”
I, with all the people who are with me, will approach the city; and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us as at the first, that we shall flee before them.
And they will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They are fleeing before us as at the first.’ So we will flee before them.
Then you shall rise from your ambush and seize the city; for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.
And it shall be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire. According to the commandment of the Lord, you shall do; behold, I have commanded you.”
So Joshua sent them forth; and they went to lie in ambush and stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai; but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
And Joshua arose early in the morning; and the people of Israel marched before him, and he went up to Ai.
ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ተዋጊዎች ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወጥተው ቀረቡ፤ ወደ ከተማዪቱም ፊት ደረሱ፤ በጋይም በምሥራቅ በኩል ሰፈሩ፤ በእነርሱና በጋይም መካከል ሸለቆ ነበረ።
ኢያሱም አምስት ሺህ ሰዎችን ወስዶ በቤቴልና በጋይ መካከል በጋይ ባሕር በኩል ይከብቡ ዘንድ አስቀመጣቸው።
ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሠራዊቶቻቸውን በከተማው መስዕ በኩል አኖሩ፤ ዳርቻውም እስከ ከተማው ባሕር ድረስ ነው፤ ኢያሱም በዚያች ሌሊት ወደ ሸለቆው መካከል ሄደ።
የጋይም ንጉሥ በሰማ ጊዜ ፈጥኖ ሄደ። የከተማዪቱም ሰዎች ወጡ፤ እርሱና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በተወሰነው ጊዜ በዓረባ ፊት ባለው አንድ ስፍራ እስራኤልን በጦርነት ተቀበሉአቸው፤ እርሱ ግን ከከተማዪቱ በስተኋላ እንደ ተደበቁ አያውቅም ነበር።
በደረሱባቸውም ጊዜ ኢያሱና እስራኤል ሁሉ ከፊታቸው አፈገፈጉ፤ በምድረ በዳው መንገድም ሸሹ።
የሀገሪቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ ተጠሩ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ተከትለው አሳደዱአቸው፤ ከከተማዪቱም እንዲርቁ አደረጓቸው።
በጋይና በቤቴልም ውስጥ እስራኤልን ለማሳደድ ያልወጣ ሰው አልነበረም፤ ከተማዪቱንም ከፍተው ተዉ፤ እስራኤልንም አሳደዱት።
እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን፥ “ጋይን በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁና በእጅህ ያለውን ጦር በላይዋ ዘርጋ፤ ከተማዪቱንም የከበቡአት ፈጥነው ከስፍራቸው ይነሣሉ” አለው፤ ኢያሱም በከተማዋ ላይ በእጁ ያለውን ጦር ዘረጋ።
የተደበቁትም ፈጥነው ከስፍራቸው ተነሡ፤ ኢያሱም እጁን በዘረጋ ጊዜ ወጡ፤ ወደ ከተማዋም ገብተው ያዙአት፤ ፈጥነውም በእሳት አቃጠሉአት።
የጋይም ሰዎች ወደ ኋላቸው ዞረው በተመለከቱ ጊዜ የከተማዪቱ ጢስ ወደ ሰማይ ሲወጣ አዩ፤ ወዲህና ወዲያ መሸሽ አልቻሉም፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳም የሸሹ ሕዝብ በሚያሳድዱአቸው ላይ ተመለሱ።
And it came to pass that Joshua, and all Israel, besieged the city, and when they beheld the smoke of the city ascending to heaven, they turned back and smote the men of Ai.

And they went forth from the city and took possession; and among the hosts of the children of Israel, they were smitten; for they were as one, and there was not one that remained or turned back, and they smote them.
And the king of Ai did not die until they brought him unto Joshua.

And the children of Israel followed after them, and when they were in the place where they had been, in the valley and in the wilderness, the men of Ai smote them; and all fell by the sword, and after they had smitten them, Joshua turned back unto Ai and destroyed it with the sword.
And in that day, all that fell, both man and woman, of the men of Ai, were twelve thousand souls.
And Joshua did not withdraw his hand until he had utterly destroyed the men of Ai.
Nevertheless, the Lord commanded Joshua, saying, "This city shall be devoted to destruction, and all that is therein shall be for the children of Israel."
And Joshua burned the city with fire; it became a heap forever; and it shall not be inhabited unto this day.

And the king of Ai was hanged upon a tree until evening; and as the sun went down, Joshua commanded that they take his body down from the tree and cast it at the entrance of the city, and raise over it a great heap of stones, which remains unto this day.

sections.title: The Law of Moses was given upon the mountain of Gabal.

verses.text: የዚያ ጊዜም ኢያሱ በጌባል ተራራ ላይ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያን ሠራ።
የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዳዘዘ፥ በሙሴም ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው፥ መሠዊያው ካልተወቀረና ብረት ካልነካው ድንጋይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፤ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት ሠዋ።
ኢያሱም በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ፊት በድንጋዮቹ ላይ ሙሴ የጻፈውን ይህን ሁለተኛውን ሕግ በድንጋዮች ላይ ጻፈ።

የእስራኤልንም ሕዝብ አስቀድሞ ይባርኩአቸው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ፥ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቻቸውም፥ ጸሓፊዎቻቸውም፥ ፈራጆቻቸውም፥ የሀገሩ ልጆችም፥ መጻተኞችም እኩሌቶቹ በገሪዛን ተራራ አጠገብ፥ እኩሌቶቹም በጌባል ተራራ አጠገብ ሆነው፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦተ ሕግ በተሸከሙት በሌዋውያን ካህናት ፊት ለፊት፥ በታቦቱም ፊት በግራና በቀኝ ቆመው ነበር።
ከዚህም በኋላ ኢያሱ በሙሴ ሕግ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ፥ የሕጉን ቃሎች ሁሉ በረከቱንና ርግማኑን አነበበ።
ኢያሱም በእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ፥ በወንዶቹም፥ በሴቶቹም፥ በሕፃናቱም፥ በመካከላቸውም በሚኖሩት መጻተኞች ፊት ሙሴ ካዘዘው ያላነበበውና ያላሰማው ቃል የለም።

sections.title: The men of Gibeon did not allow him to be deceived.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በተራራማው በሜዳውም በታላቁ ባሕር ዳር በሊባኖስም ፊት ለፊት የነበሩ ነገሥት ሁሉ፥ ኬጤዎናዊዉ፥ አሞሬዎናዊዉም፥ ከነዓናዊዉም፥ ፌርዜዎናዊዉም፥ ኤዌዎናዊዉም፥ ኢያቡሴዎናዊዉም፥ ጌርጌሴዎናዊዉም ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ፥
ኢያሱንና እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሊወጉ አንድ ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ።
በገባዖን የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ግን እግዚአብሔር በኢያሪኮና በጋይ ያደረገውን በሰሙ ጊዜ፥
እነርሱ ደግሞ ተንኰል አድርገው መጡ፤ ለራሳቸውም ስንቅ ያዙ፤ በትከሻቸውም ላይ አሮጌ ዓይበትና ያረጀና የተቀደደ የተጠቀመም የጠጅ ረዋት ተሸከሙ።
በእግራቸውም ያደረጉት ጫማ ያረጀና ማዘቢያው የተበጣጠሰ፥ ልብሳቸውም በላያቸው ያረጀ ነበረ፤ ለስንቅም የያዙት እንጀራ ሁሉ የደረቀ፥ የሻገተና የተበላሸ ነበረ።
ወደ ኢያሱና ወደ እስራኤል ጉባኤ ወደ ጌልገላ መጥተው ለኢያሱና ለእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ “ከሩቅ ሀገር መጥተናል፤ አሁንም ከእኛ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርጉ” አሉ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ኤዌዎናውያንን፥ “ምናልባት በመካከላችን የምትቀመጡ እንደ ሆነ እንዴትስ ከእናንተ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እናደርጋለን?” አሉአቸው።
ኢያሱንም፥ “እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ነን፤ ከሩቅ ሀገርም ነን” አሉት። ኢያሱም፥ “እናንተ እነማን ናችሁ? ከወዴትስ መጣችሁ?” አላቸው።
እነርሱም አሉት፥ “በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ስም እጅግ ከራቀ ሀገር ባሪያዎችህ መጥተናል፤ ዝናውንም፥ በግብፃውያንም ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥
በዮርዳኖስ ማዶም በነበሩት በሁለቱ በአሞሬዎን ነገሥት በሐሴቦን ንጉሥ በሴዎን፥ በአስታሮትና በኤድራይን በነበረው በባሳን ንጉሥ በዐግ ያደረገውን ሁሉ ሰምተናል።
O our rulers and all the people of our land: Take hold of the way of peace; go forth to greet them; for we are your servants; even now make a covenant with us, as they have said unto you.
And on the day when we arose to come unto you, this bread we took from our house for the way; and now, behold, it is dry; it is crumbled.
And these new garments of ours have filled us; behold, they are worn out; and our shoes are greatly worn because of the long journey.
And the rulers took of their provisions; but they did not ask counsel of the Lord.
And Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them to let them live; and the princes of the congregation swore unto them.
And it came to pass, when they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they dwelt among them.
And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day; now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
And the princes of the congregation swore unto them by the Lord God of Israel; and the children of Israel smote them not. And the congregation murmured against the princes.
And all the princes said unto all the congregation, “We have sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel; now therefore we may not touch them.”
And lest wrath be upon us because of the oath which we swore unto them, let us not touch them; for they are our brethren.” Thus they spoke unto them.
And the leaders said, "You shall cut down trees for the community and prepare water for your offerings." Thus did the leaders command them.
And Jesus, turning to them, said, "If you dwell among us and say, 'We are indeed very far from you,' why do you not speak to us?"
"Now you are those who have been cast out; for me and for my God, a tree shall not perish, nor shall a servant who is pure of water be lost from you," they said.

They replied to Jesus, "We, your servants, will give you all the land, so that all who dwell therein may be removed from before you, as your God, the Lord, commanded your servant Moses; truly we have heard this; therefore, we are exceedingly afraid for our souls, and we have done this matter."
"Now behold, we are in your hands; do to us as it seems good and right to you," they said.
And Jesus did likewise; he took them from the hand of the children of Israel; he did not destroy them.

And on that day, Jesus made for them trees for the community and pure water for the offerings to the Lord. Therefore, those who entered became a sanctuary for the community and for the Lord, and the Lord has had trees for the chosen place until this day.

sections.title: The Amorites were defeated in Israel.

verses.text: And it came to pass that the king of Jerusalem, Adonizedek, sent to Joshua, saying, "Come up to me, and let us make a covenant together, for they have come to us from the land of the Amorites, and they have made peace with Israel, and they are among us."
Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, all its men were mighty warriors, and they were greatly afraid.
Therefore, King Adonizedek of Jerusalem sent to King Hebron, and to King Jarmuth, and to King Lachish, and to King Eglon, saying,
"Come up to me; for they have made peace with Joshua and the children of Israel, and they are with us to fight against Gibeon."

And the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered together with all their armies and went up; they encamped against Gibeon and made war against it.

And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal, saying, "Do not withdraw your hand from your servants; come quickly to us, for all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the mountains have gathered together against us."
And Joshua, along with all the people of war who were with him, went up from Gilgal, mighty and valiant men.
And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have delivered them into your hand; not a man of them shall stand before you."
And Joshua came upon them suddenly, having marched all night from Gilgal.

And the Lord discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the road that goes up to Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

And as they fled before the children of Israel, while they were descending from Beth-horon, the Lord sent upon them a great hailstone from heaven, and they died; for more were those who died by the hailstone than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.
At that time, the Lord delivered the Amorites into the hand of the children of Israel; and he spoke to the Lord, saying, "Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and moon, in the valley of Aijalon."

And the Lord did not allow their enemies to prevail until the sun and the moon stood still in their places. Behold, this is written in this book at that time. The sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and did not hasten to go down for about a whole day.
For the Lord fought for Israel, and there was no day like that before it or after it, when the Lord hearkened to the voice of a man.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, returned to their camp at Gilgal.

sections.title: And Jesus smote the five kings of the Amorites as He had commanded.

verses.text: እነዚህም አምስት ነገሥት ሸሽተው በመቄዳ ዋሻ ተሸሸጉ።
ለኢያሱም “አምስቱ ነገሥት በመቄዳ ዋሻ ተሸሽገው ተገኙ፤” ብለው ነገሩት።
ኢያሱም እንዲህ አለ፥ “ወደ ዋሻው አፍ ታላላቅ ድንጋይ አንከባልላችሁ፥ ይጠብቋቸው ዘንድ ሰዎችን በዚያ አኑሩ፤
እናንተ ግን አትዘግዩ፤ ጠላቶቻችሁንም እስከ መጨረሻው ተከታትላችሁ ያዙአቸው፤ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋልና ወደ ከተሞቻቸው እንዳይገቡ ከልክሉአቸው፤” አለ።
እስኪጠፉም ድረስ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች በታላቅ መምታት መምታታቸውን በፈጸሙ ጊዜ፥ ከእነርሱም ያመለጡት ወደ ተመሸገ ከተማ በገቡ ጊዜ፥
ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ኢያሱ ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ መቄዳ በደኅና ተመለሱ፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ምላሱን ማንቀሳቀስ የደፈረ ማንም ሰው የለም።
ኢያሱም፥ “የዋሻውን አፍ ክፈቱ፤ እነዚያንም አምስት ነገሥት ከዋሻው ወደ እኔ አውጡአቸው” አለ።
እንዲህም አደረጉ፤ አምስቱንም ነገሥት፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን ንጉሥ፥ የኬብሮንንም ንጉሥ፥ የየርሙትንም ንጉሥ፥ የላኪስንም ንጉሥ፥ የአዶላምንም ንጉሥ ከዋሻው ወደ እርሱ አወጡአቸው።
እነዚያንም ነገሥት ወደ ኢያሱ ባመጡአቸው ጊዜ ኢያሱ የእስራኤልን ሰዎች ሁሉ ጠራ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የሄዱትን የተዋጊዎችን አለቆች “ቅረቡ፤ በእነዚህም ነገሥት አንገት ላይ እግራችሁን አኑሩ” አላቸው። ቀረቡም በአንገታቸውም ላይ እግራቸውን አኖሩ።
ኢያሱም፥ “በምትወጉአቸው በጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ ላይ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ያደርጋልና አትፍሩ፤ አትደንግጡ፤ ጽኑ፤ አይዞአችሁ” አላቸው።
And after this, they took them and killed them; and upon the five trees, they hung them; until evening, they remained hanging upon the trees.

And when the sun was about to set, he commanded them; and they descended from the trees; and they fled and hid in the place where they had been; until this day, a great stone has been placed at the mouth of the cave.

sections.title: And Jesus gathered other cities as He had done.

verses.text: And on that day, they took the city of Makedah; and they struck down its king and all its inhabitants with the sword, utterly destroying every soul therein; they left not a single one alive; just as they had done to the king of Jericho, so they did to the king of Makedah.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, passed from Makedah to Libnah; and they fought against Libnah.

And the Lord delivered into the hand of Israel the king of Libnah, and all its inhabitants; and they struck them with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying every soul therein; they left not a single one alive; just as they had done to the king of Jericho, so they did to the king of Libnah.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, passed from Libnah to Lachish; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel; and they took it on the second day; and they did to it as they had done to Libnah, striking every soul therein with the edge of the sword.
At that time, the king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people with the sword, leaving not a single one alive.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, passed from Lachish to Adullam; and they encamped there.

And the Lord delivered into the hand of Israel; and on that day, they took it; and they struck every soul therein with the edge of the sword, just as they had done to Lachish, utterly destroying every soul therein.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, went from Adullam to Hebron; and they encamped there.

And they struck down its king, and all its cities, and every soul therein with the edge of the sword; they left not a single one alive, just as they had done to Adullam, utterly destroying every soul therein.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, returned to Debir; and they went up.

And they took her, and her king, and all her cities; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; they left none remaining; just as they had done to Hebron and to her king, so did they do to Debir and to her king.

Likewise, Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and all their kings; he left none remaining; he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
And Joshua smote from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
And the Lord God of Israel delivered these kings into the hand of Israel, and they smote them, and chased them, and took their land at one time.
And Joshua, along with all Israel, returned to the camp at Gilgal.

sections.title: And Jesus prevailed over Jabez and other kings.

verses.text: And it came to pass that when King Jabin of Hazor heard this, he sent to Jobab, King of Madon, and to the King of Shimron, and to the King of Achshaph,
In the mountains of the land, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the heights, and in the valleys where the kings were,
To the eastern sea and to the Canaanite, and to the Amorite, and to the Hittite, and to the Perizzite, and to the mountain land where the Jebusite was, and to the valley and to the Evite,
They went out with all their hosts, and their number was as the sand of the sea for multitude; and they had many horses and chariots.
And all these kings came and assembled together, and they encamped by the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

And the Lord said unto Joshua, “Fear them not; for I have delivered them into thy hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee. Thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.”
So Joshua and all the people of war with him came against them suddenly by the waters of Merom, and fell upon them.

And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him; he hough their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
And in those days Joshua turned back and captured Hazor; and he smote its king with the sword; for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
And they killed all the people who were in her with the sword; they did not spare any who had breath in them; they utterly destroyed all of them; and they burned Assyria with fire.
And the servant of the Lord, Moses, commanded, saying, "You shall destroy all these kingdoms and their cities, and you shall strike them with the sword; you shall completely destroy them."
Except for those whom they burned, Israel did not destroy any other cities that were in their regions.

And the children of Israel took all the spoils of these cities for themselves, but they struck all the people with the sword until they had destroyed them; they did not spare any who had breath in them.
And the Lord commanded His servant Moses, and so Moses commanded Joshua; and Joshua did likewise; and the Lord did not leave anything that He had commanded Moses unfulfilled.

sections.title: Jesus took other nations as His own.

verses.text: ኢያሱም ያን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ተራራማውን፥ ደቡቡንም ሁሉ፥ የጎሶምንም ምድር ሁሉ ፥ ሜዳውንም፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ያለውንም፥ የእስራኤልንም ተራራማውንና ቆላውን ያዘ፤
እስከ ሴይርም ከሚያወጣው ከኤኬል ተራራ ጀምሮ ከአርሞንዔም ተራራ በታች እስከ ሊባኖስ ሜዳና እስከ በላጋድ ድረስ፤ ንጉሦቻቸውን ሁሉ ይዞ መታቸው፤ ገደላቸውም።
ኢያሱም ብዙ ዘመን ከእነዚሁ ነገሥታት ሁሉ ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር።
በገባዖን ከሚኖሩ ከኤዎናውያን በቀር፤ እስራኤል ያልያዙት ከተማ አልነበረም፥ ሁሉን በጦርነት ያዙ።
እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ፥ ያጠፉአቸው ዘንድ እንዳይራሩላቸው ፈጽመው እንዲያጠፉአቸው፥ ከእስራኤል ጋር ይጋጠሙ ዘንድ ልባቸውን እንዲያደነድኑ እግዚአብሔር ልባቸውን አጸና።
በዚያ ጊዜም ኢያሱ ሄደ፤ በተራራማውም ሀገር የሚኖሩ ኤናቃውያንን ከኬብሮንና ከዳቤር፥ ከአናቦትም፥ ከእስራኤልም ተራራ ሁሉ፥ ከይሁዳም ተራራ ሁሉ አጠፋቸው፤ ኢያሱም ከከተሞቻቸው ጋር ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው።
በጋዛ፥ በጌትም፥ በአዛጦንም ከቀሩት በቀር በእስራኤል መካከል ከኤናቃውያን ማንንም አላስቀረም።
እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ኢያሱ ምድሪቱን ሁሉ ያዘ፤ ኢያሱም ለእስራኤል እንደ ክፍላቸው በየነገዳቸው ርስት አድርጎ ምድሪቱን ሰጣቸው፤ ምድሪቱም ከጦርነት ዐረፈች።

sections.title: Moses did great deeds among the kings.

verses.text: The children of Israel, who perished, from the valley of Arnon to the mountain of Hermon, all that lies to the east, the land which they inherited, is the land of the kings of the earth; these are they.
In Heshbon, which is situated by the valley of Arnon, from Aroer, and from the midst of the valley, even to the border of the children of Ammon, as far as the river Jabbok.

To the east, the land extends to the sea of Chinnereth, along the way of Assemoth, even to the sea of the Arabah, and to the salt sea; and to the south, the land belongs to Sihon, king of the Amorites, which lies beneath the mountain of Pisgah.
From the side of the Reubenites, which was settled in the cities of Astaroth and Edrei.

The mountain of Hermon, and all Bashan, as far as Gergesh and the border of Makati, even to the border of Heshbon, which belongs to Sihon, king of the Amorites, as far as the border of the land of Bashan.

Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the children of Israel smote them; and Moses, the servant of the Lord, assigned the inheritance to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, even the land.

sections.title: Jesus, the King who has granted them victory.

verses.text: These are the kings of the Canaanites whom the children of Israel and Joshua struck down in the mountains and in the lowlands, in the Jordan Valley, and in the region of the Sea of Galilee, as they journeyed towards Seir. And Joshua gave this land to the tribes of Israel as a possession.

They cast down their inheritance in the mountains and in the plains, in the Arabah, in the lowlands, in the Negev, in the region of the hills and in the valleys, in the lands of the Canaanites and the Perizzites, in the lands of the Jebusites and the Amorites, in the lands of the Hivites and the Hittites, and in the lands of the Girgashites and the Evites.
The king of Jericho, the king of the city that is near Bethel,
The king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
The king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish,
The king of Elam, the king of Gezer,
The king of Debir, the king of Gibeon,
The king of Hermon, the king of Arad,
The king of Libnah, the king of Adullam,
The king of Makkedah,
The king of Etaphad,
The king of Opher,
The king of Aphtekeres, the king of Assur,
The king of Simi'on, the king of Memrot,
The king of Azif, the king of Qades,
The king of Zeqaq, the king of Mardot, the king of Deqom who dwelt in Carmel,
The king of Edor who is in the region of Phenad, the king of Hagi who is in the region of Galya, the king of Tirsa,
All these kings were thirty and nine.

sections.title: Yet unshackled nations.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke unto Joshua, saying, “Behold, the time has passed; much land remains yet to be possessed;
This is the land that remaineth: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites, and all the land of the Canaanites;

From the wilderness that is before Egypt, even unto the five lords of the Philistines, to Gaza, to Ashdod, to Ashkelon, to Ekron, and unto the Avites, as far as the border of the Canaanites on the left hand;
From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, even unto the border of the Amorites, unto the border of Aphek;
And all the land of the Gebalites, which is in the land of the Philistines, from the mountain that is before Hermon, even unto the entrance of Hamath;

And all that dwell in the mountainous region, from Lebanon even unto Misrephothmaim, all the Sidonians; them will I drive out from before the children of Israel; only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

Now therefore, divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh; from Jordan, even unto the great sea westward, shall ye give it unto them; and the border of it shall be toward the great sea.”

sections.title: The kingdom that is situated to the east of the Jordan.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴም እንደ ሰጣቸው ከእርሱ ከምናሴ ጋር የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሙሴ የሰጣቸውን ርስታቸውን ተቀበሉ።
በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር፥ በሸለቆውም መካከል ካለችው ከተማ ጀምሮ የሚሶር ሜዳ ሁሉ እስከ ዲቦን ድረስ፥
በሐሴቦንም የነገሠ የአሞሬዎን ንጉሥ የሴዎን ከተሞችን ሁሉ እስከ አሞን ልጆች ዳርቻ ድረስ፥
ገለዓድንም፥ የጌሴሪያውያንንና የመከጢያውያንን ዳርቻ ሁሉ፥ የአርሞንዔምንም ተራራ ሁሉ፥ ባሳንንም ሁሉ፥ እስከ ሰልካ ድረስ፥
በባሳን የነበረውን፥ በአስታሮትና በኤንድራይን የነገሠውን የዐግን መንግሥት ሁሉ፤ እርሱም ከረዓይት የቀረ ነበረ፤ እነዚህንም ሙሴ አወጣቸው፤ ገደላቸውም።
የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን ጌሴሪያውያንን፥ መከጢያውያንንና ከነዓናውያንን አላጠፉአቸውም፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ጌሴሪና መከጢ በእስራኤል መካከል ይኖራሉ።
ለሌዊ ነገድ ግን ርስት አልተሰጠም፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራቸው የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ርስታቸው ነውና፥ በኢያሪኮ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሙሴ ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዳካፈላቸው እንዲሁ ተካፈሉ።

sections.title: The inheritance given to Reuben.

verses.text: ሙሴም ለሮቤል ነገድ በየወገናቸው ርስትን ሰጣቸው።
ድንበራቸውም በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ በሸለቆው መካከል ያለችው ከተማ፥ ሜሶርም ሁሉ፥
ሐሴቦን፥ በሜሶርም ያሉት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ዲቦን፥ ባሞትበዐል፥ ቤትበአልምዖን፥
ባሳን፥ ቀዲሞት፥ ሜፍዓ፥
ቂርያታይም፥ ሴባማ፥ ሲራዳት፥ በሸለቆውም ተራራ ያለችው ሲዮን፥
ቤተ ፌጎር፥ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለው ምድር፥ ቤትሲሞት፥
የሚሶር ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ በሐሴቦንም የነገሠው የአሞሬዎናውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን መንግሥት ሁሉ ነበረ፤ ሙሴም እርሱንና በምድሪቱ የተቀመጡትን የሴዎንን መሳፍንት፥ የምድያምን አለቆች ኤዊን፥ ሮቦቅን፥ ሱርን፥ ኡርን፥ ሮቤን በሲዮን የሚኖሩትንም ገደላቸው።
ሟርተኛውን የቢዖርን ልጅ በለዓምንም በአንድነት በሰይፍ ገደሉት።
የሮቤልም ልጆች ድንበር የዮርዳኖስ ወንዝና ዳርቻው ነበረ። የሮቤል ልጆች ርስት ከተሞቻቸውም መንደሮቻቸውም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

sections.title: A heritage given to Gad.

verses.text: And Moses gave unto Gad, and unto the children of Gad, according to their families, their inheritance.
And their border was from Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and the land of the children of Ammon, even half Gilead unto Aroer.
From Heshbon unto Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river unto the border of the children of Ammon.

And in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, which is the kingdom of Sihon, which was the kingdom of the Amorites. And their border was Jordan, and the land of the east side of Jordan, even the sea of Chinnereth, and the border of the east.

The inheritance of the children of Gad was according to their cities and their villages, each according to their families. And before their enemies, they turned their backs and fled; their villages and their cities were established according to their tribes.

sections.title: To Manasseh, a heritage was given, an inheritance that is complete.

verses.text: ሙሴም ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ በየወገኖቻቸው ርስት ሰጣቸው፤
ድንበራቸውም ከመሐናይም ጀምሮ የባሳን ንጉሥ የዐግ መንግሥት፥ ባሳን ሁሉ፥ በባሳንም ያሉት የኢያዕር መንደሮች ሁሉ ስድሳው ከተሞች፥ የገለዓድም እኩሌታ፥
በባሳንም ያሉት የዐግ መንግሥት ከተሞች፥ አስጣሮትና ኤድራይን ነበረ። እነዚህም ለምናሴ ልጅ ለማኪር ልጆች ሆኑ፤ ለምናሴ ልጅ ለማኪር ልጆች እኩሌታም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።
ሙሴ በምሥራቅ በኩል በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሳለ ርስት ያካፈላቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

sections.title: The inheritance that is in the valley of Jordan.

verses.text: And the children of Israel inherited the land of Canaan, which was given to them by the priest Eleazar and Joshua the son of Nun; this is the inheritance that the children of Israel received according to the tribes of their fathers.
The Lord commanded Moses to divide the inheritance among the nine tribes and the half-tribe according to their lot.
For the two tribes and the half-tribe, Moses had given them an inheritance on the east side of the Jordan, but he did not give an inheritance to the Levites among them.

The children of Joseph were Manasseh and Ephraim; they were two tribes. And for the Levites, from the cities in which they dwelt, there was no portion given to them in the land, nor did they receive any inheritance among the people.
Thus did the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses; and they divided the land.

sections.title: Hebron was given to Caleb as it had been promised.

verses.text: And the children of Judah drew near to Joshua at Gilgal; and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the word which the Lord spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and you in Kadesh Barnea.
When the servant of the Lord Moses sent me to spy out the land, I was forty years old at that time; and I brought back to him a report as it was in my heart.
But my brethren who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; yet I wholly followed the Lord my God.
Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land on which your foot has trodden shall be your inheritance and your children’s forever, because you have wholly followed the Lord my God.’

And now, behold, the Lord has kept me alive, as He said, these forty-five years, ever since the Lord spoke this word to Moses while Israel wandered in the wilderness; and now, here I am this day, eighty-five years old.
I am still as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me; my strength now is as my strength was then, for war and for going out and for coming in.

Now therefore, give me this mountain of which the Lord spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and that the cities were great and fortified. It may be that the Lord will be with me, and I shall be able to drive them out as the Lord said.”
And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.
Therefore, Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
The name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath Arba; Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

sections.title: The inheritance given to the tribe of Judah.

verses.text: The border of the children of Judah shall extend from the wilderness of Edom, from the wilderness of Zin, and shall reach as far as Kadesh.
And their southern border shall extend to the shore of the Salt Sea, and the way to Libnah shall be their boundary.

From there, it shall go out toward the ascent of Akrabbim, and it shall pass to Zin; and it shall go out to the south toward Kadesh, and it shall pass to Azmon, and it shall go out to Seradah, and it shall turn toward Kadesh in the west.
And it shall not pass to Azmon; but it shall go out toward the border of Egypt; and the exit of the border shall be by the edge of the sea; this is the border on the south.
And the border on the east shall extend to the Salt Sea, even to the Jordan; and the border on the north shall be at the end of the Jordan as far as the edge of the sea.
From there, the border shall go out to the house of Gilgal; it shall pass northward to Betharabah; and the border shall go out to the son of Reuben, to the city of Litan.

The border shall go out to the edge of the valley of Achor, on the fourth section; it shall go out before Adumim, facing southward, and it shall descend toward Gelgela; and the border shall not pass to the spring of the sun; the exit shall be near the spring of Rogel.

The border shall go out beside the valley of Hinnom, toward the south, to the city that is called Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and the border shall go out toward the north, at the valley of Rephaim, near the valley of Hinnom, facing the sea.
The border shall go out from the top of the mountain to the spring of Nefto; it shall reach to the mountain of Ephron; and it shall reach to the city of Jearim and to Baalah.

The border shall not pass to Baalah, which is by the sea; from there it shall go southward to the city of Jearim, and northward to the border of Kislon, and it shall not pass to the border of Ashtoth; it shall descend upon the city of the sun; and it shall not pass to Libnah.

And the border shall go out toward the south to the wilderness of Zin; and the border shall turn from the south to the north; and the border shall go out to the west toward the sea; and it shall not pass to the south; but it shall go out on the east and on the west; and the border of it shall be by the edge of the sea.
The border that is by the sea extended even unto the great sea and unto the border thereof. For the children of Judah, this is their border round about according to their families.

sections.title: Caleb took Hebron and Debir as he had said.

verses.text: And the Lord commanded that the portion be given to Jephunneh’s son Caleb among the children of Judah; and he gave him the city of Arba, which is the chief city of Anak. She is also known as Hebron.
And Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, destroyed the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
And thereafter, Caleb dwelt in Debir; and the name of Debir was formerly called “the city of books.”
And Caleb said, “To him who attacks the city of books and captures it, I will give my daughter Achsah as a wife.”
And his brother, Othniel the son of Kenaz, took it; and he gave him his daughter Achsah as a wife.
And she came to him and said, “Give me a blessing; for you have given me a land in the Negev, and now give me also springs of water.” And Caleb said, “What is it that you want?”
And she said, “Give me a blessing; for you have given me a land in the south, and now give me also the springs of water.” And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

sections.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Judah.

verses.text: This is the inheritance of the children of Judah by their clans.
And in the southern part of their land, as far as the border of Edom, these were the cities of the children of Judah: Bezalel, Erah, Ashor;
Ekam, Regma, Aruheil;
Qadesh, and Asorios; their dwellings;
in their settlements and their encampments;
and the cities of the Asharim, she is also Asor.
Sin, Salama, Moladah;
Serih, Bephalad;
Kolashel, Beersheba, and their dwellings.
Baala, and Bacob, and Asom;
Elahodad, Bethel, and Ermam;
Sekelak, Makerim, and Setunak;
Labos Saleh, and Ermot, the cities and their villages, numbering five;
Bekolaw, Astal, Saraa, Asa;
Rame, Tano, Idutot, Mehanes;
Ermut, Edolam, Membra, Saak, Azika;
Sekarim, Gadarn, and their settlements, ten and four cities and their villages;
Sena, Adason, Magadalgad;
Adolal, Mesefa, Yiqarul, for Kis;
Besedot Yideha, Delyam;
Kebra, Makkes, Mehakos;
Gedor, Begadyal, Noman, Mekedon, six cities and their villages.
Lemna, Etek, Anok;
Idna and Nasib;
Elam, Aquzam, Kezib Tersa, Elom, ten cities and their villages.
Aqaron with its villages and its dwellers.
From Aqaron and Gemna, beginning with all that are near to Asedoth and their villages;
Asedoth's villages and its dwellers, and Gaz's villages and its dwellers, even unto Egypt and the river, and the great sea is their boundary.
The mountains of Samir, Iuter, Sokah;
Rena, which is the city of the book.
Anon, Sekema, Esamam;
Gosom, Kelum, and Eleven cities and their villages.
Erem, Remna, and Soma;
Iyamin, Betakum, and Faquh;
Euma, the city of Arboq, and it is also Hebron, Soret, with nine cities and their villages.
Mahor, Carmel, Azib, Itan;
Iyareyel, Iyarikim, and Zaqayin;
Gabba, Temna, with nine cities and their villages.
Alewa, Betesur, Gedor;
Ma'arat, Betanot, Elteqon, with six cities and their villages.

And you, O Ephrathah, though you are little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of you shall come forth unto me he that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting. This is the city of Kiryat Baal, which is also known as the city of Jair; it is the city of the ten towns and their villages, namely: Sobah, and the two towns and their villages.
And in Badarjgis, and in Terabam, and in Enon; and in Sequeozan.
And in Naflazan and its towns, in Sidon, in Akades; seven towns and their villages.
But the Jebusites, who dwelt in Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

sections.title: A heritage given equally to Ephraim and Manasseh.

verses.text: And the children of Joseph, from their boundary near Jericho, on the eastern side, shall extend from the Jordan unto the wilderness and unto the mountainous region, and from Jericho unto Luz, it shall reach unto the place that was called Bethel;
From Bethel unto Luz, it shall reach unto the border of the country of Ataroth;
And unto the west, even unto the border of the Philistines, and unto the border of the lower Bethhoron, it shall descend; and the outlet thereof was by the sea.
And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, inherited their possessions.

sections.title: The inheritance of the children of Ephraim.

verses.text: The borders of the children of Ephraim were as follows, according to their clans: the border of their inheritance extended from Ataroth and Erhon eastward to Gezer, and it reached as far as the upper Bethoron.
And the border went westward to the sea and to the north of Akasmon, and it did not pass to the east, but it extended to Tinah and Selas, and it did not pass to the east toward Iyanok.
From Iyanok it extended to Meakon, and to Ataroth, and it did not pass to their dwellings; it reached Jericho and went out to the Jordan.
The border extended from its side to the sea as far as Kelkan and the river, and the exit was by the edge of the sea. This was the inheritance of the children of Ephraim according to their clans.
Thus, among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, there were cities set apart for the children of Ephraim, along with all their cities and their dwellings.
And in Gezer, those who dwelt there were not destroyed by the Canaanites; even to this day, they dwell among the Canaanites in Ephraim, and they became mighty.

sections.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Manasseh is as follows.

verses.text: This is the boundary of the children of Manasseh; for he is the firstborn of Joseph. And Machir, the father of Gilead, was a mighty warrior, and he had Gilead and Bashan.

And the inheritance was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Shemida, and for the children of Hepher; these were the male descendants according to their families.
For the children of Hepher, there were female descendants; but there were no male descendants. And the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

And they came near to the priest Eleazar and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the leaders, and they said, “The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren.” And by the command of the Lord, they were given an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
And their inheritance was ten portions, besides the land of Gilead and the land of Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan; for the children of Manasseh had ten portions.
And the daughters of Manasseh inherited among their brethren; and the land of Gilead was for the rest of the children of Manasseh.
The border of the children of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which lies before Shechem; and the border went along southward to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to the children of Ephraim.

And the border descended toward the south side of the river, toward the valley of the son of Hinnom, and toward the valley of Rephaim, and it extended to the south of the Jebusite city, which is Jerusalem; and the border went down to the sea.
The southern border was for Ephraim; and the northern border was for Manasseh; and the border was by the sea; and the northern border extended to Asher, and the eastern border to Issachar.
And between Issachar and Asher were Bethsan and its towns, and Dor and its towns, and Megiddo and its towns, and the third part of Naphtali; these were for Manasseh.
And the children of Manasseh caused the inhabitants of these cities to perish; yet they came to dwell in that land from among the Canaanites.
And the children of Israel were strong; they possessed the Canaanites; yet they did not utterly drive them out.

sections.title: And the tribe of Ephraim and the tribe of Manasseh sought additional inheritance.

verses.text: And the sons of Joseph said unto him, “Behold, we are a numerous people, and even unto this day, because the Lord hath blessed us, why should there be but one portion for us, and one inheritance only?” Thus they spake unto him.
And he said unto them, “If ye be a numerous people, then the mountainous land of Ephraim shall be too narrow for you; go ye up to the forest and clear a place for yourselves there.”

And they said, “The mountainous land of Ephraim is not sufficient for us; for the Canaanites who dwell in the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth-shean and in the towns thereof, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
And Joshua said unto the sons of Joseph, “If ye be a numerous people, then a single portion shall not be enough for you;

Nevertheless, the mountainous land shall be yours; though it be a forest, ye shall clear it, for it shall be yours; and if the Canaanites have chariots of iron and are strong, yet ye shall drive them out until ye have conquered them.” Thus he spake unto them.

sections.title: The division of the remaining inheritance.

verses.text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel gathered together at Shiloh; and there they set up the tabernacle of the congregation, and the land was subdued before them.
And there remained seven tribes of the children of Israel, which had not yet received their inheritance.
And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, “How long are ye slack to go to possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?”
Of every tribe ye shall send three men, and they shall rise and go through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come again to me.
They shall divide it into seven parts; Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
And ye shall answer, “We have divided the land into seven parts; bring me word again here.” And I will cast lots for you before the Lord our God.

But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and the half tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
And the men arose and went: and Joshua charged them, saying, “Go, and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me; and I will cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.”
And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book; and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord; and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

sections.title: The inheritance given to the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.text: The border of the tribe of Benjamin went out by their clans; and their territory went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

To the north, their border began at the Jordan; and the border went up to the ascent of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the hill country to the sea; and the exit was at the wilderness of Bethavara.
And the border went from there southward to Bethel, and passed along to Luz; and the border descended to the south side of the mountain that lies before Bethel, and went down to Ataroth-addar.

The border went down to the sea; and it faced the mountain that is before Bethoron, and went out toward the south; and the exit was at Kiriath-jearim, which is in the territory of the children of Judah; this was toward the sea.
The southern border was at Kiriath-jearim; and the border went down to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

The border went down to the valley of Hinnom, which is before the mountain on the south; and it was at the north of the valley of Rephaim; and it went down to the valley of Hinnom and to the south of the city of Jebus, which is Jerusalem, and went down to En-rogel.
And it did not pass by the house of Asmaveth; but it went before the house of Itamah, and it reached to Keliah; and it descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
To the north, it did not pass by the house of Rabah; but it went down to the sea road.
The border of their inheritance extended to the north toward the salt sea; and to the south, their border was the Jordan. This is the border that lies to the south.
To the east, the border was the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin by their clans.
And the children of Benjamin had these cities according to their families: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz;
Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, and Beth-el;
Ahin, Farah, and Ephraim;
Kephar-haammon, Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities and their villages.
Gibeon, Ramah, and Beeroth;
Mizpeh, Chephirah, and Mozah;
Beth-horon, and Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon;

Jerusalem, which is called the city of the Jebusites, and Gibeon, which is the city of the Amorites; three cities and their villages. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Simeon.

verses.text: And the second lot came out for the children of Simeon according to their families; and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
And these were their cities: Beersheba, Shema, Moladah;
Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem;
Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah;
Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim;
And their villages and their fields were: thirty and three cities and their villages;
Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages;
Even unto Baalath Beer, all the cities that were round about these cities were their villages. This was the inheritance of the children of Simeon according to their families.

The inheritance of the children of Simeon was part of the children of Judah; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them; therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of their families.

sections.title: An inheritance given to Zebulun.

verses.text: And the third lot came out for the children of Zebulun according to their families; and their border was as far as Sidon.
And their border extended toward the west to Maralah; and it reached to the house of Rabah; and it extended to the brook that is before Jachin.
From Zebulun to the east of Beth-Shemesh, it goes to the border of Chisloth-Tabor; and it goes out to Dabareh; and it reaches to Japhia.
Then it goes eastward to Gibbethon, and it passes by Kattath; it goes to Rimmon and to the city of Matar.
And the border was on the north side toward Hemath; the exit was at the Hanephath brook.
And Catath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities and their villages.
These are the cities and their villages for the children of Zebulun according to their families.

sections.title: A heritage given to Zebulun.

verses.text: And the fourth was Issachar, the son of Jacob.
Their border was toward Israel, from the cities of Susans;
And Agin, and Seon, and Rehet,
Ankeret, Daberoth, Kison, and Robes;
Remas, Jaon, Tomah, and Emereq, and Bersaphes were there.
Their border extended to Tabur and to Salem, toward the west, and to Beth-Samis; the boundary of their territory was the Jordan; there were sixteen cities and their villages.
The children of Issachar had these cities and their villages as their inheritance, according to their clans.

sections.title: A heritage given to Asher.

verses.text: The fifth lot was for the children of Asher, according to their clans.
Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph;
And Amimelech, Amehel, and Mahsa were there; towards the sea, it extends to Carmel, and to the cities of the Sidonians.

And it goes toward the sun rising and toward the house of the inheritance; it borders on Zebulun and on the valley of Jiphthah El, and it reaches to the south, to the house of Mehetabel and to Enhil; it does not pass by the city of Mashal.
Then it reaches to Hebron, to Rehob, to Amemah, and to Kentan, even to the great Sidon.
And its border goes to Ramah, to the spring of Misphat, and to Tyre; and its border goes to Iaseph; and the exit was at Lebonah and at Kozab, toward the sea.
Arkob, Apheq, and Rehob were also there; twenty-two cities and their villages.
The children of Asher had this inheritance according to their clans, these cities and their villages.

sections.title: A heritage given to the inheritors.

verses.text: And the sixth lot came forth for the children of Naphtali by their families.
And their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan.
And the border turned westward to Aznothtabor; and went out from thence to Hukok; and it extended southward to Zebulun, and westward to Asher, and ended at Jordan toward the sun rising.
And the cities that were fortified were these: Tzor, and Amath-dor, and Kiriath.
And Armet, and Arahim, and Assur.
And Kedesh, and Asrayis, and the spring of Assur.
And Kerioth, and Miglahari, and Bethamin, and Tesmis; ten cities and their villages.
These are the cities and their villages of the children of Naphtali by their inheritance.

sections.title: The inheritance given to Dan.

verses.text: ሰባተኛውም ዕጣ ለዳን ልጆች ወጣ።
የርስታቸውም ዳርቻ ይህ ነበረ፤ ሠራሕት፥ አሳ፥ የሰመውስ ከተማ፥
ሰሊባን፥ አሞን፥ ሴላታ፥
ኤሎን፥ ቴምናታ፥ አቃሮን፥
አልቃታ፥ ቤጌቶን፥ ጌቤላን፥
አዞር፥ ቤኔቤቃት፥ ጌትሬሞን፤
በባሕር በኩል በኢዮጴ ፊት ለፊት ካለው ዳርቻ ጋር ኢያራቆን።
የዳን ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው። የዳን ልጆችም በተራራው ላይ የሚያስጨንቋቸው አሞሬዎናውያንን አላስጨነቁአቸውም። አሞሬዎናውያንም ወደ ሸለቆዎች ይወርዱ ዘንድ አልፈቀዱላቸውም። ከእነርሱም ከርስታቸው ዳርቻ አንድ ክፍልን ወሰዱ።
የዳን ልጆችም ሄደው ለኪስን መቱአት፤ ከተማቸውንም ያዟት፤ በሰይፍም መቱአት። በውስጥዋም ተቀመጡ። ስሟንም በአባታቸው በዳን ስም ዳን ብለው ጠሩአት። አሞሬዎናውያንም በኤዶምና በሰላሚን ለመኖር ቀጠሉ። የኤፍሬማውያንም እጅ በእነርሱ ላይ በረታች። ገባሪዎችም ሆኑላቸው።

sections.title: The inheritance given to Jehoshaphat.

verses.text: And after they had divided the land according to its borders, the children of Israel gave a heritage to Jehu, the son of Hanani, in the midst of them, by the command of the Lord.
They gave her the city which is called Timnath-serah, which is in the mountainous region of Ephraim; and she built the city and dwelt therein.

This is the heritage which was given to Eleazar the priest, and to Jehu the son of Nimshi, and to the leaders of the children of Israel, in the presence of the Lord at Shiloh, by the testimony of the tabernacle, which was established by fire; and they divided the land among them.

sections.title: The cities of refuge.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው፦
“ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው፦ በሙሴ ቃል የነገርኋችሁን የመማፀኛ ከተሞችን ስጡ።
ባለማወቅ ሳይወድድ ሰውን የገደለ በዚያ ይማፀን ዘንድ፥ ለእናንተ የመማፀኛ ከተሞችን ሥሩ፤ ነፍስ የገደለ ሰውም በአደባባይ ለፍርድ እስኪቀርብ ድረስ በደም ተበቃዩ አይገደል።
ከእነዚህም ከተሞች በአንዲቱ ይማፀናል፤ በከተማዪቱም በር አደባባይ ቆሞ ለከተማዪቱ ሽማግሌዎች ነገሩን ይናገራል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ከተማዪቱ ያገቡታል። የሚቀመጥበትም ስፍራ ይሰጡታል።
ባለ ደሙ ቢያሳድደው፥ አስቀድሞ ሳይጠላው ባልንጀራውን በስሕተት ስለ ገደለው ነፍሰ ገዳዩን በእጁ አሳልፈው አይስጡት።
በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስኪቆም ድረስ ፥ በዚያም ወራት ያለው ታላቁ ካህን እስኪሞት ድረስ በዚያች ከተማ ይቀመጥ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ይመለሳል፤ ወደ ከተማውም፥ ወደ ቤቱም ሸሽቶ ወደ ወጣበትም ከተማ ይገባል።”
በንፍታሌም ባለው በተራራማው ሀገር በገሊላ ቃዴስን፥ በኤፍሬምም ባለው በተራራማው ሀገር ሴኬምን፥ በይሁዳም ባለው በተራራማው ሀገር ኬብሮን የምትባለውን የአርቦቅን ከተማ ለዩ።
በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ምሥራቅ ከሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳው በደልዳላው ስፍራ ቦሶርን፥ ከጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ኤርሞትን፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ጎላንን ለዩ።
በማኅበሩ ፊት እስኪቆምና እስኪመረመር ድረስ ባለደሙ እንዳይገድለው ሳያውቅ ሰውን የገደለ ወደዚያ እንዲማፀን፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ፥ በመካካላቸውም ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ የተመረጡ ከተሞች እነዚህ ናቸው።

sections.title: Cities given to the Levites.

verses.text: የሌዊ ልጆች አለቆች ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛር፥ ወደ ነዌም ልጅ ወደ ኢያሱ ወደ እስራኤልም ሕዝብ አባቶች ነገዶች አለቆች መጡ፤
በከነዓን ምድር ባለችው በሴሎ፥ “እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ የምንቀመጥባቸውን ከተሞች፥ ለከብቶቻችንም መሰማሪያዎች ትሰጡን ዘንድ አዝዞአል” ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ከርስታቸው እነዚህን ከተሞችና መሰማርያቸውን ለሌዋውያን ሰጡአቸው።
ለቀዓትም ወገኖች ልጆች ዕጣ ወጣ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለነበሩ ለካህኑ ለአሮን ልጆች ከይሁዳ ነገድ፥ ከስምዖንም ነገድ፥ ከብንያምም ነገድ ዐሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡአቸው።
ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ከኤፍሬም ነገድ፥ ከዳንም ነገድ፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ዐሥር ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡአቸው።
ለጌድሶንም ልጆች ከይሳኮር ነገድ፥ ከአሴርም ነገድ፥ ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ፥ በባሳንም ካለው ከምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ዐሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡአቸው።
ለሜራሪም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ከሮቤል ነገድ፥ ከጋድም ነገድ፥ ከዛብሎንም ነገድ ዐሥራ ሁለት ከተሞች ተሰጡአቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው የእስራኤል ልጆች እነዚህን ከተሞችና መሰማሪያቸውን ለሌዋውያን በዕጣ ሰጡ።
የይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ፥ የስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ፥ የብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ በስማቸው የተጠሩትን እነዚህን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።
የፊተኛው ዕጣ ለእነርሱ ስለወጣ የሌዊ ልጆች የቀዓት ወገን ለሆኑ ለአሮን ልጆች ሆኑ።
The sons of Enak gave them the city of Kiriath-arba and its surrounding villages; this is Hebron, which is situated in the hill country of Judah.
And he gave the fields and the villages of the city to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as an inheritance.
And to the priest, to the sons of Aaron, he gave these cities; to the city of refuge, which is Hebron, and its suburbs; and to Libnah and its suburbs,
and to Ether and its suburbs, and to Ashan and its suburbs;
and to Helon and its suburbs, and to Debir and its suburbs;
and to Asan and its suburbs, and to Jotah and its suburbs, and to Beth-shemesh and its suburbs; from these, he gave nine cities from two tribes.
And from the tribe of Benjamin, he gave Geba and its suburbs, and Gathrimmon and its suburbs;
and Anathoth and its suburbs, and Almon and its suburbs; thus, he gave four cities.
The cities of the priests, the sons of Aaron, were thirteen in all, with their suburbs.
And to the rest of the Levites, to the children of Kohath, he gave cities from the tribe of Ephraim.
To the city of refuge, which is Shechem, and its suburbs, and to Gezer and its suburbs;
To Kibzaim and its suburbs, to Betheron and its suburbs; these four cities were given to them.
From Dan, and from the way of Elkotah and its suburbs, to Gabbathon and its suburbs;
To Elon and its suburbs, to Geterahmon and its suburbs; these four cities were given to them.
From Manasseh, from the way of Ikhletah and its suburbs, to Jabesh and its suburbs; these two cities were given to them.
The remaining children of the sons of Aaron were ten cities, with their suburbs, from all their families.

And to the Levites, to the children of Gershon, from Manasseh, from the way of Ikhletah, to the city of refuge, which is Golan in Bashan, and its suburbs, to Bosor and its suburbs; these two cities were given to them.
From Issachar, from the way of Kishon and its suburbs, to Dabrath and its suburbs;
To Remeth and its suburbs, to Ain Ganim and its suburbs; these four cities were given to them.
From Asher, from the way of Mesehal and its suburbs, to Abdon and its suburbs;
ሔልቃትንንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ረዓብንና መሰማርያዋን፤ አራቱንም ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።
ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን በገሊላ ውስጥ ቃዴስንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ኤማትንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ቃርቴንንና መሰማሪያዋን፤ ሦስቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።
የጌድሶን ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ በየወገኖቻቸው ዐሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች ከመሰማርያቸው ጋር ናቸው።
ከሌዋውያን ለቀሩት ለሜራሪ ልጆች ወገን ከዛብሎን ነገድ ዮቅናምንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ቃዴስንና መሰማርያዋን፥
ዲምናንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ሴላንና መሰማርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።
በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በኢያሪኮ በኩል ከሮቤል ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ በሚሶን ምድረ በዳ ቦሶርንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ኢያዜርንና መሰማርያዋን፤
ቄዴሞትንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ሜፍዐትንና መሰማርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።
ከጋድም ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን በገለዓድ ውስጥ ራሞትንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ቃሚንንና መሰማርያዋን፤
ሐሴቦንንና መሰማርያዋን፥ ኢያዜርንና መሰማርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።
ከሌዊ ወገኖች የቀሩት የሜራሪ ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ዕጣቸውም ዐሥራ ሁለት ከተማ ነበረ።
And among the cities of the Levites, which were in the inheritance of the children of Israel, there were forty-eight cities with their surrounding pasture lands.

And these cities were each with their surrounding pasture lands; thus were all these cities. [And Joshua divided the land according to their borders. And the children of Israel gave to Joshua, at the command of the Lord, the city which he desired, even Timnathserah, which is situated in the mountain of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt therein. And Joshua took the stones which had been hewn from the rock in the valley of the Dead Sea and brought them to Timnathserah.]

sections.title: And Israel shall possess the land and dwell therein in rest.

verses.text: And the Lord gave unto them the land which He had sworn unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

And the Lord, as He had said unto their fathers, removed from them all their enemies round about; and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

sections.title: And Jesus, having come from the region of Jordan, was as one who was baptized.

verses.text: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ የሮቤልን ልጆችና የጋድን ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኩሌታ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦
“የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ሰምታችኋል፤ እኔም ላዘዝኋችሁ ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዛችኋል፤
ይህንም ያህል ብዙ ጊዜ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንድሞቻችሁን አልተዋችሁም፤ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቃችኋል።
አሁንም አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራቸው ወንድሞቻችሁን አሳርፎአቸዋል፤ አሁን እንግዲህ ተመለሱ፤ ወደ ቤታችሁና የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ሰጣችሁ ወደ ርስታችሁ ምድር ሂዱ።
ብቻ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ትእዛዙንና ሕጉን ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርንም ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገዱንም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንም ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ እርሱንም ትከተሉ ዘንድ፥ በፍጹምም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ታመልኩት ዘንድ እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ።”
ኢያሱም መረቃቸው፤ አሰናበታቸውም፤ ወደ ቤታቸውም ሄዱ።
ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሙሴ በባሳን ውስጥ ርስት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር፤ ለቀረው ለእኩሌታው ግን ኢያሱ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በባሕር በኩል በወንድሞቻቸው መካከል ርስት ሰጣቸው። ኢያሱም ወደ ቤታቸው በአሰናበታቸው ጊዜ እንዲህ ብሎ መረቃቸው፦
“በብዙ ብልጥግና፥ በእጅግም ብዙ ከብት፥ በብርም፥ በወርቅም፥ በናስም፥ በብረትም፥ በእጅግም ብዙ ልብስ ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ፤ የጠላቶቻችሁንም ምርኮ ከወንድሞቻችሁ ጋር ተካፈሉ።”
የሮቤልም ልጆች የጋድም ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሄዱ፤ በሙሴም እጅ በተሰጠ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ተቀበሉት ወደ ርስታቸው ወደ ገለዓድ ምድር ይገቡ ዘንድ በከነዓን ምድር ካለችው ከሴሎ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

sections.title: A sanctuary made by the side of the Jordan.

verses.text: And when the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh came to the region of Gilead, which is in the land of Canaan, they built there a great altar by the Jordan River.

And when the children of Israel heard of it, they gathered together at Shiloh to go up against them, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, as they had built the altar.
And when the children of Israel heard this, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered together at Shiloh to go up against them.

And the children of Israel sent Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead.
And with him were ten princes, one from each of the chief houses of every tribe of Israel; and each one was the head of the house of his fathers among the thousands of Israel.
And they came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead, and they spoke to them, saying,

Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, “What treachery is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, in that you have built for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel this day against the Lord?
Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord?
Now therefore, if you turn away from following the Lord today, then tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

But if your land is unclean, then cross over to the land of the possession of the Lord, where the Lord's tabernacle stands, and take possession among us; but do not rebel against the Lord, nor rebel against us by building yourselves an altar besides the altar of the Lord our God.

"Is it not true that because of the sin committed by the son of Zerah, the anger of the Lord did not fall upon all the congregation of Israel? And if he alone bears the burden of his sin, shall he alone die?"
"And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, answered and said to the leaders of the congregation of Israel, saying,"
"The Lord is God; He is Master; the Lord is the God of the Ammonites; He knows it. And Israel knows it. If we have done evil in the sight of the Lord, let us not be spared today."
"Let us worship our God, the Lord, and offer the sacrifices that are pleasing to Him, and let us present the offerings of safety, as He has commanded us."

"But if fear has arisen in our hearts, saying, 'What do your children have to do with the children of Israel, the God of the Lord?' lest they say to us, 'This is what we have done,' you, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, the half-tribe of Manasseh,"
"For the Lord has made a boundary between us and you, O Jordan, and there is no chance for you with the Lord; thus they shall say to you, 'Let not your children turn away from the Lord.'"
"Therefore, let us not build an altar; but for the sacrifices that are pleasing to Him, or for the offerings, let it not be so."

"But between us and you, and after us, in our generations and in your generations, let our sacrifices and offerings, and our offerings of safety be to the Lord, lest your children say, 'There is no chance for you with the Lord.'"

"And when this is done, saying to us or to our generations, 'Behold, this is a witness of what our fathers have done for the Lord; it is a witness between us and you, but it is not for the sacrifices or offerings.'"

"Before our God, the Lord, there is no other altar for the sacrifices or for the offerings of peace, nor for the offerings of safety; the altar we have built is for the Lord, and today we shall worship Him, and we shall not forsake Him."

And the priest Phinehas and the leaders of the congregation, along with all the children of Israel who were with him, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, when they heard the words that were spoken, they were silent; they rejoiced greatly.

And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, said to the children of Reuben and to the children of Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, “This day we know that the Lord is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the Lord; now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.”

And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, with the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, returned from the land of Gilead to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word.

And the matter pleased the children of Israel; and they blessed God, and spoke no more of going against the children of Reuben and Gad, to make war against them, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad dwelt.
And he called the altar “A Witness between us,” for it is a witness between us that the Lord is God.

sections.title: The discourse of Isaiah.
